text:
maya: Quick idea  small OSS 'onboarding mini-kit' we can drop in GH READMEs + a short email drip. Goal: faster time-to-first-success for devs and clear inbound lead routing into webinar signups and product trials. Thoughts?

 dave: Love it. Focus on 3 things: 1) quickstart in <5 minutes, 2) benchmark snippet showing latency/cost for a common use case, 3) CTA to a short webinar + 'open office hours'.

 arjun: Can we include a tiny Docker + local dev example? most OSS folks want something they can run locally without GPUs. `docker run redwood/minikit:latest` (placeholder).

 sophie: For outbound/email, I suggest a 3-email drip: day0 welcome + quickstart, day2 benchmark & tips, day7 webinar invite + office hours. Keep subject lines A/B-able.

 liam: +1. I sketched two subject lines for each email, feel free to copy:

```
Email 1 subj A: "Your Redwood mini-kit: Get started with a dev sample in <5 minutes"
Email 1 subj B: "Try Redwood locally — no GPU required"
Email 2 subj A: "Speed & cost: a real-world benchmark for your app"
Email 2 subj B: "How we got 3x throughput for chat workloads"
Email 3 subj A: "Join our quick live demo + office hours"
Email 3 subj B: "Webinar: deploying inference that doesn’t break the bank"
```

 maya: Nice. For inbound routing: landing page form should have a checkbox for "interested in Dedicated/Private" to route to sales, otherwise go to self-serve nurture. Can we add UTM tracking for each email and README badge links?

 dave: Yes. Proposed routing rules: form -> if checkbox sales=true OR corporate email domain -> create lead in SFDC + tag "mini-kit-oss"; else -> add to marketing nurture list "oss-minikit". Also tag source=readme or source=email.

 sophie: I'll draft the email copy and short webinar landing page. Can someone prep the benchmark snippet (latency/cost) for the reference app? Keep it reproducible: command + outputs.

 arjun: I'll put together a lightweight benchmark that runs on CPU and a small GPU sample (colab GPU). Will include a table with tokens/sec and $/1k tokens estimates. Sample snippet: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hello"}'` + timing info.

 liam: For the README badge, mockup: `[Try the mini-kit](https://redwood.ai/mini-kit?utm_source=readme&utm_campaign=oss_minikit)` and `![mini-kit status](https://redwood.ai/badges/mini-kit.svg)`. We should track clicks and conversions separately for badge vs CTA button.

 maya: Timeline: copy + landing page draft by Tue EOD, benchmark + demo by Wed, email templates + routing config by Thu. Webinar scheduled next Wed. Can everyone confirm availability? :spiral_calendar_pad:

 dave: I can do demo + office hours slot next Wed.

 arjun: Benchmarks ready Wed morning.

 sophie: Copy + landing page draft by Tue. I'll post to this thread when done.

 marketing-bot: Reminder: create tracking ticket in JIRA -> MARK-4321 and assign to maya for campaign orchestration.

 maya: Thanks — I'll create MARK-4321 and drop the Figma + copy links here once ready. Also thinking short GitHub Actions workflow to auto-update the mini-kit Docker image on merge. @arjun can you add a tiny GH Action snippet to repo?

 arjun: Yep — will add a `ci/build-minikit.yml` that builds and pushes to GHCR on tag.

 liam: One more thought — add a simple prompt set for common tasks (chat, summarize, extract) so devs can see realistic outputs. Might help reduce churn.

 dave: Agree. We'll include a `prompts.md` and a quick eval script so people can reproduce quality checks.

 maya: Great progress. Once Sophie posts the copy I'll start the routing setup with eng-ops. Thanks all! :rocket:
